name: openemr/openemr
what_it_is: OpenEMR is an open source electronic health records (EHR) and medical practice management application written in PHP. It covers clinical documentation, scheduling, electronic billing, patient portal, and exposes FHIR R4 and REST APIs for interoperability.
components: SMART on FHIR v2.2.0 launch framework
protocols: Bulk FHIR Export (NDJSON over async HTTP)
measurement: API token introspection endpoint for token validity checks
CI pipeline badges: syntax, styling, unit tests, JS tests, PHPStan, Rector, ShellCheck, Docker Compose lint, Dockerfile lint, Inferno certification test, Composer checks
configuration: Enable/disable REST API and FHIR API via Administration settings
Site base URL for OAuth2 and FHIR endpoint resolution
Granular FHIR scopes with permission flags and category filters
Multisite tenant routing (site identifier in API path)
constraints: Requires HTTPS/TLS for all API and OAuth2 communication; HTTP-only deployments cannot use OAuth2 or FHIR
MariaDB/MySQL is the only supported database backend
Patient Portal API is documented as experimental and not production-stable
Node.js 22.x is required to build front-end assets from source
SMART app launch and OAuth2 flows require a publicly resolvable or explicitly configured Site Address
Multi-tenancy is path-based only; no per-tenant database isolation is described
notable_absences: No built-in time-series or analytics database
No native telemedicine or video-call module
No built-in lab instrument integration layer
No dedicated message broker or event streaming component
